note: Evidence for the fr1 decision. Does air_quality_worst_classification let us pick a nonattainment major-source threshold for a non-ozone pollutant? No. Four coordinates via POST /v1/fetch/batch (12 credits) plus one via POST /v1/fetch (3 credits).
